preconditions.description: The number of packets is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
Each packet contains between 1 and 1000 balloons, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output_k >= 1 and output_k <= n and all(1 <= output_index <= n for output_index in output_indices))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a non-negative integer k followed by k distinct integers from 1 to n, representing the indices of the packets to give to Grigory.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (sum(a_i for i in output_indices) != sum(a_i for i in range(n) if i+1 not in output_indices))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 or the sum of balloons in Grigory's packets is not equal to the sum of balloons in Andrew's packets.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(1 <= output_index <= n for output_index in output_indices) and len(set(output_indices)) == len(output_indices))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 or the indices given to Grigory are distinct and all between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output_k >= 1 and output_k <= n and all(1 <= output_index <= n for output_index in output_indices) and len(set(output_indices)) == output_k)
postconditions.description: The output is -1 or the number of packets given to Grigory is between 1 and n, and the indices are distinct and all between 1 and n.
